response.justification: Bogdan is a capable senior/staff-level individual contributor with broad full-stack and systems experience, but he has no executive leadership track record, no history scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+, no production multi-agent AI system ownership, and no fintech-infrastructure (credit, payments, risk) depth. The role requires a CTO with 5+ years of senior technical leadership at scale-ups and hands-on production agentic-AI architecture in regulated financial environments, none of which is evidenced here.
strengths: Strong, diverse hands-on engineering background across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency systems
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq
Demonstrated craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source leadership) showing technical rigor and mentorship inclination
concerns: No evidence of executive or C-level leadership, or managing/scaling teams of 10-30+ engineers
No production experience with multi-agent AI systems in regulated or high-stakes financial contexts
Limited fintech-infrastructure experience (only brief pricing-team work at Optilyz) and no credit/risk/payments systems ownership

key_factors.factor: Lack of executive leadership and team-scaling track record
No production multi-agent AI or regulated fintech system experience
Solid full-stack and distributed-systems engineering skillset
